text: Ko onon yo gomɗimɓe, Si on immanike juulugol, hara non hiɗon wonndi e tayre tokosere, ko yo o salligo looton geece mon ɗen e juuɗe ɗen haa ka coɓɓuli, maswon ko'e mon ɗen, looton koyɗe mon ɗen haa ka kolɓule. Si on laatike janabante, ko lootagol lonngal, si tawii non on nawnu waqtu on pooɗike, maa hara hiɗon e hoore laawol, maa hara on huntu haaju ɓaawo hoggo, maa rennduɗon e rewɓe ɓen on heɓaali ndiyam ko laɓɓinoron, faandoree leydi ndin taamagol, mashon geece mon ɗen e juuɗe ɗen. Alla Faandanaaki on ɓitteende e Ñaawooje Makko ɗen, O Sar'inanii on lonto salligi si ndiyam heɓaaki ; no O Timminirana on Neemaaji Makko ɗin e dow mooɗon, belajo'o, on yettay Neemaaji Alla ɗin e dow mooɗon, hara on yeddaali ɗi.
